g1|variants|customer-material info recor.summary: Customer-material info records link specific customer material numbers and descriptions to internal SAP material numbers, enabling customer-specific terminology and pricing rules in OTC. Variants differ by whether the record is created for a specific sales organization, a distribution channel, or globally without organizational levels.

variants.name: Customer-Material Info Record with Sales Area
variants.when_used: When a customer uses their own material number and description which applies exclusively to a specific sales organization and distribution channel combination.
variants.key_config: Created via transaction VD51 or VD52, specifying Customer, Material, Sales Organization, and Distribution Channel.

variants.name: Customer-Material Info Record without Sales Area (Global)
variants.when_used: When a customer-specific material number and description apply globally across all sales areas within the client without restriction.
values: Sales Order entry across all regions
variants.key_config: Created via transaction VD51 without entering a sales organization, allowing cross-sales area validity.

variants.name: Customer-Material Info Record with Plant Assignment
variants.when_used: When specific delivery plant defaults or customer material descriptions must be tied to a delivering plant in the sales order.
variants.key_config: Configured to store a default delivering plant in the info record which overrides standard customer or material master plant defaults.

g1|core|customer-material info records|c.title: Customer-Material Info Record with Sales Area
g1|core|customer-material info records|c.story: Imagine a world where customers call materials by their own secret names instead of the official catalog codes, and the system instantly translates them so nobody gets confused. In technical terms, the Customer-Material Info Record (CMIR) links a specific customer's material number and description to the internal SAP material master within a defined sales organization and distribution channel.
g1|core|customer-material info records|c.why_business_needs_it: It prevents costly order entry errors by automatically substituting customer-specific item numbers and descriptions during sales order creation. Furthermore, it allows businesses to store customer-specific data such as custom item text, delivery tolerances, and specific partial delivery rules.

modules.role: Maintains CMIR master data, executes customer material substitution during sales order entry, and applies customer-specific sales text.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) via billing document hand-off and MM (Materials Management) via availability check and delivery creation.

prerequisites: Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, and Division must be configured (SPRO > Enterprise Structure > Definition > Sales and Distribution)

Click the New Entries button on the application toolbar
Type A00001 in the Procedure field
Type Standard Material Determination in the Description field
Select the newly created row and double-click on Procedures in the dialog structure sidebar
Click New Entries to assign condition types to the procedure

Save (Ctrl+S) and assign the configuration to a local customizing transport request

g1|core|customer-material info records|c.title: Customer-Material Info Record without Sales Area (Global)
g1|core|customer-material info records|c.story: Just like nicknames make it easier to talk about your favorite toys without using their long box names, a customer-material info record lets your sales team use the customer's own product code when creating orders. Technically, the Customer-Material Info Record (CMIR) links a customer's specific material number and description to your internal material master record. When configured at the global client level without a sales area, this record applies universally across all sales organizations and distribution channels.
g1|core|customer-material info records|c.why_business_needs_it: It prevents costly order entry errors by automatically translating the customer's part number into your internal SKU regardless of which sales area creates the order. This ensures consistent order processing and customer satisfaction globally without duplicating master data maintenance across multiple sales offices.

modules.role: Maintains customer-material info records and translates customer material numbers during sales order entry.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for billing and revenue recognition using the resolved internal material.

modules.role: Provides the foundational internal material master data referenced by the global CMIR.

best_practices.practice: Maintain global customer-material info records only when pricing and descriptions apply uniformly across all sales areas.
best_practices.why: Using global records reduces master data maintenance overhead while ensuring consistent baseline data for shared materials.

best_practices.practice: Enforce plant-specific customer-material info record assignments when customer-specific packaging or routing requires dedicated logistics execution.
best_practices.why: Explicit plant assignment prevents erroneous automatic plant determination during sales order entry and ensures accurate outbound delivery scheduling.

best_practices.practice: Schedule periodic audit reports using transaction VD59 to identify and purge obsolete customer-material info records.
best_practices.why: Regular cleanup prevents outdated customer material numbers or blocked parameters from corrupting active sales order processing.

best_practices.practice: Integrate customer-material info record creation into the new customer onboarding workflow via SAP Master Data Governance.
best_practices.why: Early creation of customer material numbers ensures seamless inbound EDI order processing without manual IDoc intervention.

best_practices.practice: Validate customer material descriptions in customer-material info records against output control requirements before batch activation.
best_practices.why: Ensures printed and electronic commercial documents correctly display customer part descriptions, preventing billing disputes.

best_practices.practice: Restrict write authorizations for transaction VD51 and VD52 to designated central master data governance teams.
best_practices.why: Prevents unauthorized overrides of commercial agreements, pricing parameters, and delivery blocks by operational sales users.

best_practices.practice: Leverage LSMW or SAP S/4HANA migration cockpit for mass updates of customer-material info records during portfolio rationalization.
best_practices.why: Mass maintenance capabilities ensure rapid synchronization of customer material numbers when internal SAP material numbers change.

g1|panel|customer-material info records.otc_impact: Customer-material info records sit at the very beginning of the Order-to-Cash execution chain, bridging the gap between customer-specific commercial terms and SAP master data. By maintaining specific material descriptions, order blocks, minimum quantities, and delivery tolerances at the customer-material or customer-material-plant level, they directly drive order entry accuracy and downstream fulfillment. When this master data is misconfigured or missing, sales orders fail on text determination, deliveries block due to unexpected tolerances, and billing goes out with incorrect customer part numbers, degrading the Order-to-Cash cycle time and customer satisfaction KPIs.

panel_qa.question: Why should we maintain customer-material info records instead of relying purely on standard material masters or customer master records?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Customer-material info records are essential when specific trading partners require their own material numbers, descriptions, or delivery constraints printed on sales documents. SAP is configured this way using transaction VD51 to establish a hierarchical link between customer and material, overriding standard Material Master (MM03) descriptions. The key configuration involves setting the customer-material number and short text in table KNMT, which feeds sales order item text and pricing routines. The leadership value is eliminating manual order-entry errors, reducing invoice disputes, and increasing Order-to-Cash automation rates by up to 25%. Moving forward, we leverage SAP S/4HANA Business Partner and Fiori master data apps for streamlined maintenance. The weak answer is stating we use them just because users prefer seeing their own part numbers.
panel_qa.trap: We use them because users like seeing their own part numbers on the screen.

panel_qa.question: What is our architectural strategy regarding the sales area versus global levels for customer-material info records?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Global info records without a sales area provide a fallback for cross-company business, while sales-area-specific records enforce strict regional commercial boundaries. SAP evaluates access sequence table A504 before table A505 based on condition technique pricing and text determination procedures. The key configuration requires defining the access sequence in transaction V/07 to prioritize sales organization and distribution channel specific keys over general records. The leadership value is reducing maintenance overhead while maintaining rigorous governance over localized delivery tolerances and order blocks. Looking ahead, SAP S/4HANA simplifies data models, but strict adherence to sales area separation prevents cross-region pricing leaks. The weak answer is claiming it does not matter which level we use as long as the text appears.
panel_qa.trap: It does not matter which level we use as long as the text appears on the sales order.

panel_qa.question: How do plant assignments within customer-material info records impact our outbound delivery and availability checks?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Assigning a specific plant to a customer-material info record forces automatic source plant determination during sales order creation, overriding customer master and material master defaults. SAP executes this through plant determination rules where table KNMT-WERKS takes precedence in schedule line generation. The key configuration involves populating the delivering plant field in transaction VD51, ensuring ATP (Available-to-Promise) checks look at the correct inventory stock segment. The leadership value is preventing intercompany shipping errors and cutting transportation costs by routing fulfillment from the optimal warehouse. Next, we will integrate this with advanced ATP in SAP S/4HANA for real-time constrained allocation. The weak answer is saying plant determination is solely driven by the customer master shipping conditions.
panel_qa.trap: Plant determination is solely driven by the customer master shipping conditions and material master.

panel_qa.question: What financial risk exposure do we face if delivery tolerances set in customer-material info records are mismanaged?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Over-delivery and under-delivery tolerances defined in customer-material info records dictate whether outbound deliveries and billing documents can be processed outside exact ordered quantities. SAP controls this via over-delivery tolerance field UEBTK and under-delivery tolerance field UNTTO in table KNMT, which flow into delivery item categories. The key configuration requires setting strict percentage limits in transaction VD51 to prevent unauthorized inventory leakage and mismatched billing amounts. The leadership value is safeguarding revenue integrity, preventing customer over-billing disputes, and maintaining strict audit compliance. Next, we are linking these tolerances to automated billing block releases in SAP Convergent Invoicing where applicable. The weak answer is stating that delivery tolerances do not affect financial reconciliation.
panel_qa.trap: Delivery tolerances only affect the warehouse and do not impact financial reconciliation.

panel_qa.question: How do we handle mass creation and maintenance of customer-material info records during acquisitions or ERP migrations?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Mass maintenance of customer-material info records prevents operational bottlenecks during high-volume cutovers by utilizing standardized data migration tools. SAP executes this using Data Migration Cockpit, LSMW (Legacy System Migration Workbench), or direct IDoc processing via message type COND_A. The key configuration involves mapping legacy customer numbers and material numbers to internal SAP keys using transaction LT01 or migration object SD_CUST_MAT_INFO. The leadership value is accelerating time-to-market for new business units and lowering total cost of ownership through automated data loading. Looking forward, we utilize SAP S/4HANA migration cockpit web-based templates for all mass updates. The weak answer is telling the board that users will manually recreate all records in production.
panel_qa.trap: We will have our sales support team manually recreate all fifty thousand records in production.

panel_qa.question: What specific OTC errors occur when a customer-material info record has an active order block, and how do we resolve them?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: When an order block is flagged in a customer-material info record, the sales order item receives an automatic status block preventing delivery creation. SAP surfaces this via message class V1, number 342, halting downstream logistics execution. The key configuration involves setting the order block indicator in transaction VD51 and verifying the rejection reason setup in transaction V/08. The leadership value is stopping unauthorized shipments to high-risk accounts before inventory leaves the warehouse. Next, we implement automated workflow notifications to credit controllers when an info record block is triggered. The weak answer is suggesting we delete the info record entirely to let the order go through.
panel_qa.trap: We just delete the info record entirely to let the order go through without checking.
